outcome: Success rate of trial of labor after two cesarean sections (TOLA2C)
cohort: 532 patients who underwent TOLA2C at a teaching hospital in the Democratic Republic of Congo from 2015 to 2020
finding: The success rate of TOLA2C was 76.1%, and factors associated with success included birth spacing ≥24 months, previous vaginal delivery, intercalated vaginal delivery, cervical dilation >6 cm and/or complete dilation on arrival in the delivery room, and oxytocin stimulation.
